reasoning: llm-d Router (formerly the Inference Scheduler) is a Go project that builds long-running network services, each with its own Konflux Dockerfile: the Endpoint Picker (EPP), an Envoy ext-proc gRPC server that makes routing decisions for LLM inference traffic based on load and prefix-cache locality; the P/D disaggregation sidecar that runs next to model servers; and a coordinator. It defines CRDs (InferenceObjective, InferenceModelRewrite) and watches them along with InferencePool. But it only reads these resources to configure routing. It does not reconcile or manage the lifecycle of other workloads the way an operator does. It is deployed through Helm charts and manifests as a data-plane component, so 'service' is the best fit.
